grid.layout_notes: CMS: 5×3 base 243 ways; Sticky Win Spins expand to 5×5 / 3,125 ways.

win_system.notes: 243 base ways; up to 3,125 via Sticky Win Spins expansion.

respins.how_it_works: Any win → Sticky Win Spins up to 3 levels: +rows then full non-win respin; Pyramid Wilds on last level.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: First two Sticky Win levels add rows toward 5×5.

other.name: Pyramid Wilds
other.how_it_works: Last Sticky Win level: pyramid wheel red tip → column transforms to Pyramid Wild; regular Wild→double.

wilds.name: Wild / Pyramid Wild / Double Wild
wilds.behavior: Pyramid Wild transforms column (except Bonus/Wild); regular Wild→double (counts as 2).

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3+ → Akhenaten Spins: 3→8 spins, each extra Bonus +2 spins; during FS each extra Bonus +1 spin.

multipliers.name: Sticky Win multiplier (FS)
multipliers.behavior: Each Sticky Win Spin raises win mult for rest of bonus.

base_game_loop.summary: 5×3 243 ways; any win→Sticky Win Spins (≤3 levels→3125 ways/Pyramid Wilds). 3 Bonus→8 Akhenaten (+2/extra). Buy 8@65× or 12@105×. Cap unknown on CMS.

phases.name: Spin + Sticky Win
phases.what_happens: Evaluate ways; Sticky Win Spins expand/respins/Pyramid Wilds.

modes.name: Akhenaten Spins
modes.spins_awarded: 8 (+2 per extra Bonus at trigger; +1 per extra Bonus during FS)
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Sticky Win mult persists for bonus.
modes.progressive_state: Each Sticky Win Spin increases win multiplier.

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: Award 8 (+2 per extra Bonus at trigger; +1 per extra Bonus during FS).

modes.effects: Sticky Win Spins active; rising mult.

features.name: Sticky Win Spins
features.effects: Up to 3 respin levels; expand to 3125 ways; Pyramid Wild chance.

numeric_limits.max_win_notes: Not stated on CMS features excerpt.
